limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.

The raw ProPakistani IMF link was not accessible in this cloud session. Its committed timestamp converts to 09:52:42 PKT; the same review start and scope were verified in a full Business Recorder article published at 06:05 PKT.

The linked Mettis MACTER FY26 article was inaccessible. That item is recorded only as headline-level evidence and remains outside the repository's tracked universe, so no stock or sector rating is created from it.

Still-valid current-session OGDC, PPL, MARI and Oil Marketing ratings are carried forward unchanged. Other newly added raw items are duplicates of already reviewed context or do not establish a traceable direct or configured-sector cash-flow link to the tracked universe.
